description: Same architecture as exp706 (E=96, d_v=16, 84.94M params). Pure soft (hybrid_smooth) training from scratch for 16K steps. Effective batch = bs=48 * grad_accum=2 = 49152 tokens/step (originally targeted bs=96 but OOM'd at hybrid_smooth, used grad_accum to maintain effective batch). NO hard-mode switch. Tests the LIMIT of pure-soft training at this architecture given large batch and long horizon. Compute: 16K * 49152 = 786M tokens (~2.4x exp719's 328M, ~12x exp706's 65.5M). Comparison: exp719 (same arch, 8K soft bs=16 then 8K hard bs=64) = 1.2963 @ 84.94M. exp720 tests whether pure soft can match/exceed that, or whether the hard-mode switch is essential.
